metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Surface Operations — Surface Modeling Workspace
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor Surface Modeling environment. Inventor's surface tools are thinner than hyperCAD-S because most CAD work stays solid; surfaces are used for closure (Boundary Patch / Stitch), repair (Repair Bodies / Replace Face), and conversion (Sculpt / Ruled Surface). Catalog covers 12 operations: boundary closure, stitch / unstitch, trim / extend, replace / move face, sculpt (surface→solid), ruled surface, repair bodies, and 2 reference-curve generators (silhouette + surface intersection).
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Surface Modeling Reference; Inventor API Reference — PartFeatures (BoundaryPatchFeatures, StitchFeatures, TrimFeatures, ExtendSurfaceFeatures, ReplaceFaceFeatures, SculptFeatures, RuledSurfaceFeatures, RepairBodyFeatures, MoveFaceFeatures, SilhouetteCurveFeatures, IntersectionCurveFeatures)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor surface features

BOUNDARY_PATCH.description: Close a gap bounded by edges / curves with a fitted patch surface. Inventor supports per-edge continuity conditions (G0 / G1 tangent / G2 curvature). Optional weight per edge biases the patch toward / away from each boundary.

parameters.name: Boundary
parameters.description: Closed loop of edges / sketch curves / surface edges

parameters.name: Internal Constraint Curves
parameters.description: Optional internal curves the patch must pass through

parameters.name: Auto Approximate
parameters.description: Allow automatic refit to remove kinks

STITCH.description: Combine adjacent surface bodies into a single quilt or, when the result is watertight, into a solid body. Stitch tolerance controls how loose adjacent edges are allowed to be before stitching fails.

parameters.name: Maintain Original
parameters.description: Keep source surfaces as separate bodies

UNSTITCH.description: Reverse-of-stitch: separate a stitched quilt or solid back into its constituent surface bodies. Optional face-list selection partial-unstitches only specific faces.

parameters.name: Faces to Unstitch
parameters.description: Subset of faces (omit for full unstitch)

TRIM_SURFACE.description: Cut a surface with a curve, surface, or plane and discard one side. Inventor supports planar / curve / surface cutters and a Side selector that picks which fragment to keep.

parameters.name: Cutter
parameters.description: Curve / surface / plane to trim against

EXTEND_SURFACE.description: Extend the boundary of a surface by a given distance, or up to a target surface / face. Two extension styles: Tangent (continuous derivative) and Linear (flat extension along boundary tangent).

REPLACE_FACE.description: Substitute a face on a solid body with a target surface. The substitute surface must extend beyond the original face footprint; trimming is automatic.

parameters.name: Heal Adjacent
parameters.description: Auto-trim/extend adjacent faces to match new face boundary

SCULPT.description: Combine surface bodies with solid bodies in a single boolean step. Add (build solid bounded by surfaces) or Subtract (carve solid using surface as cutter). Sculpt is Inventor's primary surface→solid bridge.

parameters.name: Bounding Geometry
parameters.description: Surfaces / faces / planes that define the volume

parameters.name: Target Body
parameters.description: Solid to operate on (for add / subtract)

RULED_SURFACE.description: Generate a ruled surface from edges or curves. Inventor supports 3 ruling directions: Normal (perpendicular to source face), Tangent (smooth continuation), Vector (along an explicit direction). Optional alternate-direction toggle for sweep-back rulings.

REPAIR_BODIES.description: Heal / diagnose surface bodies: detect open edges, sliver faces, self-intersections, and small gaps. Optional auto-repair attempts to close gaps within tolerance and remove slivers below the area threshold.

MOVE_FACE.description: Direct-edit translation of selected faces. Three modes: Triad (3-axis gizmo), Free-Drag (preview), and From-To (point-to-point). Operates without re-evaluating the feature tree, so it bypasses parametric history.

SILHOUETTE_CURVE.description: Generate the silhouette curve of a surface or solid relative to a viewing direction. Used as input for trim, draft, or projection workflows.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Plane / axis / face whose normal defines view direction

SURFACE_INTERSECT.description: Generate the intersection curve(s) between two surface bodies or between a surface and a solid. Returns a 3D curve usable as a sketch path or sweep guide.
